title: SOTA/efficiency/numerical-stability steering
description: Advisory steering across gsd's plan/execute/verify/ship lifecycle toward SOTA numerics: internally consistent and project-consistent, unambiguous, complete, efficient, quiet-running, agent-facing code -- plus the single blocking plan:post gate that mechanically enforces a compliant Alternatives Considered section on every plan in a phase.

sota-numerics.enabled.description: Master toggle for both the advisory steering fragments and the blocking plan:post Alternatives Considered gate — the only config key this capability declares.

predicate.command: _SN=.gsd/capabilities/sota-numerics; _G="${GSD_HOME:-$HOME}/$_SN"; SOTA_SCRIPT="./$_SN/scripts/check-alternatives.py"; if [ -f "$SOTA_SCRIPT" ]; then [ -f "$_G/scripts/check-alternatives.py" ] && python3 -I -c 'import json,re,sys; v=lambda p: tuple(map(int,re.match(r"(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)",json.load(open(p))["version"]).groups())); sys.exit(0 if v(sys.argv[2])>v(sys.argv[1]) else 1)' "./$_SN/capability.json" "$_G/capability.json" 2>/dev/null && SOTA_SCRIPT="$_G/scripts/check-alternatives.py"; else SOTA_SCRIPT="$_G/scripts/check-alternatives.py"; fi; test -f "$SOTA_SCRIPT" || { echo "sota-numerics: gate script not found at project or global scope -- run 'gsd capability install https://github.com/davdittrich/sota-numerics.git#<tag>' (or a local path to a checkout), or reopen the session to let the SessionStart auto-install run" >&2; exit 1; }; python3 -I "$SOTA_SCRIPT"

gates.description: onError is deliberately "halt": it routes a malformed predicate declaration or an unknown predicate kind — the only outcomes gsd-core's predicate evaluator throws on. Every runtime outcome of the check command itself is mapped to a block verdict instead: a missing python3 exits 127, a crash exits 1, and the 30s timeout all produce block, and only exit 0 does not. A blocking gate that silently skips when its own manifest is malformed defeats its purpose. Do not "fix" this back to "skip".
